# Chat Application Project Instructions

## Project Overview

A beginner-friendly 1-to-1 chat application similar to WhatsApp with user registration, login, and real-time messaging.

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: React with Vite
- Backend: Node.js with Express
- Database: MongoDB with Mongoose
- Real-time: Socket.io

## Project Structure

- `/backend` - Node.js server and API
- `/frontend` - React application

## Progress Tracking

- [x] Create project structure and copilot-instructions.md
- [x] Set up backend with Node.js and Express
- [x] Create MongoDB models and database setup
- [x] Set up frontend with React (Vite)
- [x] Create authentication components (Login/Register)
- [x] Create chat interface and components
- [x] Set up Socket.io for real-time messaging
- [x] Install dependencies and test the application

## Project Complete! ✅

All components have been created and dependencies installed. See QUICKSTART.md for instructions on running the application.
